title: INDOPACOM: large disc using clouds as concealment

tellings.quote: Large disc using clouds as concealment.

plain: A large disc is said to have been seen hiding in clouds somewhere in the area covered by INDOPACOM, the US military command for the Indian and Pacific Ocean region. Michels reads this one line aloud from a report called Immaculate Constellation, said to be a list of military sightings of unexplained objects and linked to a Pentagon whistleblower named Matthew Brown. If true, it would suggest an object that behaves as though it is trying not to be seen.
